errors.text_span: Всички процентни стойности са изписани вътре в съответните сектори.
errors.evidence: The statement claims all sectors have percentage values written inside them, but the chart only shows values for two of the four sectors (57.1% and 26.2%). The orange and blue sectors do not have values displayed on them.

errors.text_span: най-големият сектор (жълт) е разположен в дясната част
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the largest sector (yellow) is located on the right side. In the chart, the yellow sector occupies the bottom and left portions of the pie.
